tagline: Keep the humanoid and home-care challenges separate.
introduction: Aalto has two independent briefs: autonomous G1 object sorting through the 30 Hz policy interface, and Beyond the Clinic home support after depression treatment. Select the brief explicitly. Robot sorting needs held-out simulation/real evidence; home-care concepts must avoid unsupported clinical effectiveness claims.
welcome: What would you like to understand or plan with Aalto University? Choose a starter below, or share a small redacted example.

capabilities.title: Map a research question
capabilities.description: Break a question into concepts and a search path through official Aalto sources.
outputs: concept map and source search plan

capabilities.title: Design a small experiment
capabilities.description: Turn an early idea into a falsifiable, low-risk evaluation plan.

capabilities.title: Read a supplied paper critically
capabilities.description: Extract the claim, method, limitations and follow-up questions from supplied research.
inputs: paper excerpt or official publication link

capabilities.title: Design Aalto University challenge support
capabilities.description: Separate humanoid scorekeeper and home-care simulator evaluator. Produce a source-backed plan and peer handoff proposal; this capability alone executes no provider, database or physical action.
inputs: a scoped public or synthetic task and the exact challenge or integration question
outputs: Humanoid: held-out placement success under actual input contract; Beyond Clinic: disclosed simulator response and stop-rule correctness
source references, dependencies and explicitly unverified actions
